result:
I finished both of my sub-tasks, and both PRs are merged with CI and CD green.

- **PLAT-104-1 (PR #1):** `billingUrl` in `libs/shared-contracts` is now `https://homelab.local/billing/v2`. This lib lives in the monorepo and is built into the apps. It has no registry release, so I left its version at 1.0.0. CD ignores `libs/`, so this PR deployed nothing.
- **PLAT-104-2 (PR #2):** I bumped `apps/sub-route-billing` to 1.0.1 so CD would detect a change and deploy it. A local build showed the new URL in the bundle.

I posted a handoff note for dev-b with release class `patch`, since the command needs one. It says there's no published version and no dependency update to run. It also says dev-b has to change something under their own app directory, or CD won't deploy it. I haven't seen a reply from dev-b.

I didn't expect a shared-config change to ship nothing by itself. I also noticed that `docs/ci-cd.md` says CD only detects `core-shell` and `sub-route-billing`. So dev-b's reports app may not deploy through the normal pipeline, and I flagged that in the note.

I used two PRs because the config change had to land before the billing app's rebuild.
